personal.title: Frontend Developer
personal.tagline: Building scalable web architecture & digital infrastructure for 30+ global projects focused on business growth
personal.bio: I’m a Senior Frontend Engineer and Systems Architect with over 4 years of experience crafting high-performance, scalable web applications. My expertise is deeply rooted in the React and Next.js ecosystem, and TypeScript, where I specialize in building complex frontend architectures that are fast, accessible, and aligned with business growth. While my core focus is engineering intuitive user experiences, I am proficient in designing the end-to-end digital infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration between frontend interfaces, AI-driven automation, and robust backend systems.
